title: Extending low-degree coefficients
statement: Let $\ell$ be a nonnegative integer and assign a coefficient in $\mathbb{F}_2$ to every subset of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ of size at most $\ell$. Extend this family by assigning coefficient zero to every larger subset. The resulting algebraic normal form agrees, at every $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, with the sum of the assigned coefficients times their corresponding monomials over subsets of size at most $\ell$.
hypotheses_covered: coefficient assigned to every subset of size at most $\ell$
